resources.string: Pulse has not been loaded yet.
Reliability, BUMP Vault, Social Passport and city-history metrics stay hidden until their server-authoritative v1.1 capability is active.
This build does not fabricate meetups, cities, reliability, BUMP history or activity metrics. This surface activates only when those values are backed by canonical server data.

A real Map requires canonical place identities, server viewport queries, privacy-safe coordinates and clustering. v1.0 has place/zone text only, so this build does not invent map pins or user locations.
Use Pulse for the current server-backed discovery flow.

Fly Now/Travel/Motion needs server-time TTL, proximity and motion buckets, driver/passenger safety and privacy guardrails. Those authorities do not exist in the v1.0 API, so Join/Pass is not faked here.
Current real join/request actions are available in Pulse.
